title: Black Friday Deals for Frienjis!
contentHtml:
It's the internet's biggest weekend for online deals. Food nerds like you deserve a good bargain, so we've compiled our best Black Friday and Cyber Weekend deals below.

Join Our Patreon Community with 30% Off!

This Cyber Weekend, we're offering 30% off annual memberships for both paid tiers here on Patreon. If you've been thinking about joining the Cookbook Club or upgrading to a Super Frienji, now's your chance! By joining now, you'll secure this 30% off rate for the entire life of your subscription.

Please note, this discount is only available for annual subscriptions. Click here to head to our membership options and toggle on the "pay annually" switch to join! Join by Monday, November 30, to get the discount.

Gift guides galore!

My Gift Guides

I've put together some gift guides of my tried-and-true favorites and the tools I’ve taken an active role in developing, designing, and testing. These are the things that bring me true joy when I head into the kitchen and I want you to feel the same.

We've put together these gift guides by price range:

  • Essential Kitchen Tools Under $20 🔗

  • Essential Kitchen Tools Under $100 🔗

  • Essential Kitchen Tools Under $300 🔗

  • Kitchen Tools for Folks Who Have Been Extra Good 🔗

By food theme:

  • Gift Guide for Grill Nerds 🔗

  • Gift Guide for Pizza Nerds 🔗

  • Gift Guide for Wok Nerds 🔗

And included some wildcards to balance it all out:

  • Pantry Essentials 🔗

  • Gift Guide for Cookbook & Food Writing Nerds 🔗

  • Gift Guide for True Frienjis 🔗

KAN x Kenji Shi-toku knife.

The Popup Shop: KAN Knives

Introducing The Popup Shop! A new addition to our merchandise site, this space celebrates some of my favorite collaborators. First up is the one and only KAN Knives!

I've been using and recommending KAN Kitchen Knives for nearly ten years. These knives strike a balance between performance and price, are made of premium materials, and they come with top-tier customer support. The inventory includes the KAN x Kenji Shi-toku, among others! Head to the Popup Shop to check it out.

BADOP! The perfect 1:1 swap for salt.

BADOP! Black Friday Deal

Looking for stocking stuffers for all the food nerds in your life? These BADOP! Founder's Tins are available for a limited time only and available through December 2nd with a special deal: Buy 2 tins and get 15% off or 3 tins for 20% off. Get the sale over on badop.co.

P.S. Local Author Holiday Signing & Celebration

Seattle-based Frienjis, this one is for you!

Join me and fellow local cookbook authors Christina Wood, Stuart Lane, Yenvy & Quynh-Vy Pham, and Zola Gregory for a special holiday signing & celebration in collaboration with Book Larder! We'll be gathering on Friday, December 11th, at the Fremont Abbey. Registration is required. Learn more about the event and reserve your spot!

10% of all proceeds will be donated to Second Harvest, supporting their continued work providing food assistance to communities impacted by this summer's wildfires in Eastern Washington.
